name: Cheese Dip in a Bread Bowl
description: A warm cheese and ham dip served in a hollowed-out bread loaf.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the bread loaf and hollow out most of the soft bread inside.
Mix together the cream cheese, sour cream, ham, green pepper, green onion, cheddar cheese, Tabasco sauce, and Worcestershire sauce.
Fill the hollowed bread loaf with the cheese mixture and replace the lid.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Serve hot with the reserved bread chunks and fresh veggies for dipping.

keywords: bread bowl dip, ham and cheese dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Hot Cheese Dip
_similar.description: A creamy bacon and cheddar dip baked inside a pumpernickel bread shell.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the pumpernickel loaf and hollow it out, leaving a thick shell.
Mix the cream cheese, mayonnaise, cheddar cheese, and bacon bits until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into the hollowed-out bread.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil, leaving the hole with the cheese mixture uncovered.
Bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.
Serve hot with the bread pieces.

_similar.keywords: pumpernickel dip, hot bacon dip, cheddar dip

_similar.name: Crab Dip
_similar.description: A rich and creamy crab dip made with cream cheese, crab meat, and green onions, served with crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Blend all ingredients together, including the juice from the crab meat, until smooth.
Serve with crackers.

_similar.keywords: crab dip, seafood dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Nacho Dip
_similar.description: A creamy and flavorful dip made with cream cheese, sour cream, and taco seasoning, topped with salsa, cheese, and chopped vegetables.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine cream cheese, sour cream, and taco seasoning mix until smooth.
Spread the mixture in a large glass pan.
Spread salsa sauce over the cream cheese layer.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the salsa layer.
Add chopped red pepper, green pepper, and tomato on top.
Serve with baked nacho chips.

_similar.keywords: nacho dip, creamy dip, taco seasoning, salsa dip

_similar.name: Nacho Fiesta Dip
_similar.description: A layered dip featuring cottage cheese, cream cheese, and taco seasoning, topped with lettuce, tomatoes, and cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: Large bag tortilla chips for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Mix cottage cheese, cream cheese, and taco seasoning together in a blender until well combined.
Place the mixture in a large bowl lined with Saran Wrap and refrigerate covered for 1 hour.
Remove the dip from the bowl by tipping it onto a platter or large plate and peeling off the Saran Wrap.
Cover the dip with shredded lettuce, then diced tomatoes, and finally grated cheddar cheese.
Surround with tortilla chips and serve.

_similar.keywords: layered dip, nacho fiesta, taco seasoning, cheesy dip

_similar.name: Crab & Cheese Platter
_similar.description: A layered seafood appetizer featuring a creamy cheese base topped with cocktail sauce and crab meat.
recipeIngredient: 2 large packages (8 oz each) cream cheese

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together the cream cheese, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, mayonnaise and onion flakes in a blender, or beat with an electric mixer, until smooth and creamy.
Spread cheese mixture evenly over the surface of a large round platter, leaving room around the outside for a row of crackers.
Press the centre of the cheese mixture down lightly to make a slightly raised border, about ½ to 1 in wide, around the outer edge.
Spread seafood cocktail sauce over the cheese layer within this border, leaving an outside rim of the cheese layer showing.
Drain the crab meat and spread it over the sauce layer, again leaving a border of seafood sauce showing.
Serve with crackers or vegetables.

_similar.keywords: crab dip, layered platter, seafood appetizer
